Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

时长：10秒
宽高比：9:16
参考：@图片1，锁定主角面部、发型和人物造型，不额外描述或更换穿着
音频：真实城市夜景环境声、助跑脚步、强风呼啸、弹性装置低频回弹声、落地闷响、朋友欢呼；无对白、无旁白、无字幕
整体风格：极限运动手机实拍，真实高空距离，强烈临场感，一镜到底，轻微手持与高速运动模糊，拒绝游戏CG感

全局连续性

场景：
夜晚城市高楼屋顶，绿色直升机停机坪，黄色圆形标线，低矮水泥护墙。两栋高楼之间形成垂直街道峡谷，地面可见车辆、路灯和十字路口。

下方装置：
街道中央设置一座巨大的圆形黑色弹性回弹装置，中心为深黑色弹性面，外圈环绕连续彩虹灯带。装置尺寸巨大，正对屋顶边缘，作为主角下落和反弹的准确落点。

主体：
@图片1为唯一主角。人物身份、面部和造型全程一致。

旁观者：
三至四名朋友站在屋顶左侧，用手机拍摄并等待主角返回。不能抢占主体。

镜头连续性

全片为屋顶朋友手持手机拍摄的一镜到底。

摄影者先在主角身后跟拍助跑；主角跃下后，摄影者迅速冲到护墙边俯拍；随后镜头持续锁定主角，从垂直向下逐渐抬向天空；主角反弹回到屋顶后，镜头恢复平视。

不切镜、不瞬移、不更换视角。

特技机制

动作闭环必须固定：

屋顶助跑 → 飞越护墙 → 高空下落 → 命中圆形弹性面中心 → 装置深度下陷 → 强力回弹 → 主角高速升空 → 空中团身翻腾 → 展体定位 → 双脚返回同一屋顶 → 屈膝落地 → 欢呼庆祝。

镜头1（00:00-00:10）高空反弹往返特技

主体：
@图片1主角站在屋顶停机坪后方，正对远处护墙。朋友位于画面左侧拍摄。

动作：

00:00-00:01.50｜快速助跑

主角背对镜头，从停机坪中央快速冲向屋顶边缘。步幅逐渐加大，身体前倾，双臂自然摆动。

摄影者手持手机紧跟主角向前跑，画面产生真实脚步震动。朋友站在左侧举起手机，紧张注视。

00:01.50-00:02.30｜跃出屋顶

主角最后一步用力蹬地，身体越过低矮护墙。离开屋顶的瞬间，双臂向左右展开，身体稍微前倾，主动朝两栋高楼之间俯冲。

摄影者冲到护墙边，镜头快速向下俯转，始终把主角保持在画面中央。

00:02.30-00:04.80｜高空下落

镜头接近垂直俯拍。主角沿楼宇之间的空间快速下降，身体由前倾逐渐调整为面向下方，双臂保持展开以稳定方向。

随着主角下降，街道、车辆和十字路口迅速显现。巨型黑色圆形弹性装置从画面下方出现，彩虹灯环照亮周围建筑。

主角的下降轨迹必须准确对准黑色弹性面的圆心，不能偏向灯环或撞向建筑。

00:04.80-00:05.50｜命中中心

主角身体落在黑色弹性面正中心。弹性面受到冲击后明显向下形成深凹，彩虹灯环保持固定，装置不能破裂。

短暂压缩后，弹性面以巨大力量恢复原状，将主角垂直向上弹出。

必须清楚表现“接触—下陷—压缩—回弹”四个阶段，不能在接触前提前反向飞行。

00:05.50-00:08.20｜高速反弹与空中翻腾

摄影者仍站在屋顶护墙边。画面底部短暂出现摄影者的双脚，强化真实第一视角和高空距离。

主角从圆形装置中心高速升起，沿原来的垂直路线返回屋顶。摄影机从垂直向下持续向上抬起，跟随主角穿过城市楼宇之间的空间。

主角升空后收紧腰腹，双膝靠近胸口，双臂抱住小腿，形成紧凑团身，在空中完成连续快速翻腾。不要锁定具体翻转方向，以自然连续旋转为准。

主角接近屋顶高度时开始打开身体：松开双腿、抬起头寻找屋顶、双脚转向下方，双臂向两侧展开保持平衡。

00:08.20-00:09.40｜返回屋顶

主角高速接近镜头，从屋顶护墙外侧越回停机坪。双脚同时接触绿色地面，膝盖和髋部深度弯曲，以低位蹲姿吸收落地冲击。

落地必须具有明显重量：鞋底或脚掌接触、腿部压缩、身体下沉、轻微反弹恢复。不能站直着轻飘落地。

摄影者快速后退半步，避免主角撞上镜头，同时继续保持正面近景。

00:09.40-00:10.00｜真实庆祝

主角从蹲姿快速站起，兴奋地看向镜头，张口欢呼。屋顶朋友冲进画面，举着手机围过来，拍肩、挥拳、大声庆祝。

镜头因人群靠近产生轻微晃动，以真实手机自拍视频状态结束。

环境：
高楼灯光、街道车辆和彩虹灯环保持空间位置稳定。下落和上升必须发生在同一条垂直路线，主角最后返回起跳的同一栋屋顶。

镜头：
24mm手机广角，一镜到底。开始为背后低位跟拍；跃下后变为越肩俯拍；回弹时由垂直俯拍连续抬升至仰拍；最后恢复平视近景。

风格：
真实夜间手机曝光，高楼具有准确透视和尺度。下落阶段风声增强，城市灯光形成自然运动拖影；主角返回屋顶时速度极快，但人体轮廓仍然清晰。

约束：
这是经过专业布置的虚构极限运动场景。必须完整显示圆形弹性装置承接并反弹主角，不能表现为无保护自由坠落。

主角下降和上升必须连续可追踪。回弹来自黑色弹性面的物理压缩，不是飞行、瞬移、绳索拖拽或超能力。

负面：

改变@图片1人物造型，重新设计服装，服装漂移，面部漂移，人物替换，
中途切镜，机位瞬移，场景跳变，摄影者突然出现在地面，第三人称航拍，
主角直接飞行，悬浮，隐形绳索拉升，反重力，瞬间返回屋顶，
没有弹性装置，错误落点，落在彩虹灯环，撞击建筑，撞击护墙，
接触前提前反弹，弹性面没有下陷，装置破裂，装置变形消失，
下落方向改变，上升路线偏移，身体穿过弹性面，人物尺寸异常，
翻腾时四肢扭曲，多余手臂，多余腿，关节反折，身体融化，复制人物，
落地无重量，站直落地，脚部穿透地面，跌倒受伤，血液，严重伤害，
朋友提前挡住镜头，群众冻结，手机变形，高楼弯曲，车辆漂浮，
动漫渲染，游戏CG，塑料皮肤，廉价绿幕，过度光效，过度慢动作，
字幕，屏幕文字，水印，品牌标志，旁白，额外对白

Seedance 2.5 prompt 👇

Duration: 10秒 (10 seconds)
Aspect ratio: 9:16
Reference: @图片1 (@Image 1), lock the protagonist’s face, hairstyle and character styling, do not additionally describe or change the clothing
Audio: real city night ambient sound, run-up footsteps, strong wind howling, low-frequency rebound sound of the elastic device, muffled landing thud, friends cheering; no dialogue, no narration, no subtitles
Overall style: extreme sports phone-shot footage, real high-altitude distance, strong sense of presence, one continuous shot, slight handheld and high-speed motion blur, reject game CG feel

GLOBAL CONTINUITY

Setting:
Nighttime city high-rise rooftop, green helicopter landing pad, yellow circular markings, low concrete parapet. A vertical street canyon forms between two high-rises, with vehicles, streetlights and an intersection visible on the ground.

Lower apparatus:
A huge circular black elastic rebound device is set in the center of the street, with a deep black elastic surface at the center and a continuous rainbow light strip surrounding the outer ring. The device is huge in size, facing the rooftop edge, serving as the exact landing point for the protagonist’s fall and rebound.

Main subject:
@图片1 (@Image 1) is the sole protagonist. The character’s identity, face and styling remain consistent throughout.

Bystanders:
Three to four friends stand on the left side of the rooftop, filming with phones and waiting for the protagonist to return. They must not take over the subject.

CAMERA CONTINUITY

The entire film is one continuous shot filmed by a friend on the rooftop holding a phone.

The cameraperson first follows behind the protagonist filming the run-up; after the protagonist leaps off, the cameraperson quickly rushes to the parapet edge and shoots downward; then the camera continuously locks onto the protagonist, gradually tilting up from vertical downward toward the sky; after the protagonist rebounds back to the rooftop, the camera returns to eye level.

No cuts, no teleporting, no changing viewpoints.

STUNT ENGINE

The action loop must be fixed:

rooftop run-up → leap over the parapet → high-altitude fall → hit the center of the circular elastic surface → device sinks deeply → powerful rebound → protagonist rises at high speed → mid-air tuck and flip → body extension and positioning → both feet return to the same rooftop → knee-bent landing → cheering celebration.

SHOT 1 (00:00-00:10) High-altitude rebound round-trip stunt

Subject:
@图片1 (@Image 1) protagonist stands behind the rooftop landing pad, facing the distant parapet. Friends are on the left side of the frame filming.

Action:

00:00-00:01.50｜Fast run-up

The protagonist, with back to camera, sprints from the center of the landing pad toward the rooftop edge. Stride gradually lengthens, body leans forward, arms swing naturally.

The cameraperson holds the phone and closely follows the protagonist running forward, the frame producing real footstep vibration. Friends stand on the left holding up phones, watching nervously.

00:01.50-00:02.30｜Leap off the rooftop

The protagonist pushes hard off the ground on the last step, body crossing over the low parapet. At the instant of leaving the rooftop, both arms spread to the left and right, body leans slightly forward, actively diving toward the space between the two high-rises.

The cameraperson rushes to the parapet edge, the camera quickly tilts downward, always keeping the protagonist in the center of the frame.

00:02.30-00:04.80｜High-altitude fall

The camera approaches a vertical downward shot. The protagonist descends rapidly along the space between the buildings, body gradually adjusting from leaning forward to facing downward, arms kept spread to stabilize direction.

As the protagonist descends, the street, vehicles and intersection quickly appear. The giant black circular elastic device appears from the lower part of the frame, the rainbow light ring illuminating the surrounding buildings.

The protagonist’s descent trajectory must accurately align with the center of the black elastic surface, must not deviate toward the light ring or collide with buildings.

00:04.80-00:05.50｜Hit the center

The protagonist’s body lands exactly at the center of the black elastic surface. The elastic surface visibly forms a deep depression after impact, the rainbow light ring remains fixed, the device must not rupture.

After brief compression, the elastic surface restores to its original state with enormous force, launching the protagonist vertically upward.

The four stages of “contact—sinking—compression—rebound” must be clearly shown; the protagonist must not fly backward before contact.

00:05.50-00:08.20｜High-speed rebound and mid-air flips

The cameraperson is still standing at the rooftop parapet edge. The cameraperson’s feet briefly appear at the bottom of the frame, reinforcing the real first-person perspective and high-altitude distance.

The protagonist rises at high speed from the center of the circular device, returning to the rooftop along the original vertical route. The camera continuously tilts upward from vertical downward, following the protagonist through the space between the city buildings.

After rising, the protagonist tightens the waist and abdomen, knees close to the chest, arms hug the calves, forming a compact tuck, completing continuous rapid flips in the air. Do not lock a specific flip direction; natural continuous rotation is the standard.

As the protagonist approaches rooftop height, the body begins to open: legs release, head lifts to look for the rooftop, feet turn downward, arms spread to both sides to maintain balance.

00:08.20-00:09.40｜Return to the rooftop

The protagonist approaches the camera at high speed, crossing back over the landing pad from outside the rooftop parapet. Both feet contact the green ground simultaneously, knees and hips bend deeply, absorbing the landing impact in a low squat.

The landing must have obvious weight: sole or foot contact, leg compression, body sinking, slight rebound recovery. Must not land standing straight and light.

The cameraperson quickly steps back half a step to avoid the protagonist colliding with the camera, while continuing to maintain a frontal close-up.

00:09.40-00:10.00｜Real celebration

The protagonist quickly stands up from the squat, excitedly looks at the camera, mouth open cheering. Rooftop friends rush into the frame, holding up phones and surrounding him, patting shoulders, pumping fists, cheering loudly.

The camera shakes slightly due to the crowd approaching, ending in a real phone selfie-video state.

Environment:
High-rise lights, street vehicles and the rainbow light ring maintain stable spatial positions. The fall and rise must occur along the same vertical route, and the protagonist finally returns to the same rooftop from which he jumped.

Camera:
24mm phone wide angle, one continuous shot. Starts as a low-angle follow shot from behind; after the leap it becomes an over-the-shoulder downward shot; during the rebound it continuously tilts up from vertical downward to an upward shot; finally returns to eye-level close-up.

Style:
Real nighttime phone exposure, high-rises with accurate perspective and scale. Wind sound intensifies during the fall, city lights form natural motion trails; when the protagonist returns to the rooftop the speed is extremely fast, but the human silhouette remains clear.

Constraints:
This is a fictional extreme sports scene with professional setup. The circular elastic device must be fully shown catching and rebounding the protagonist; it must not appear as unprotected free fall.

The protagonist’s descent and ascent must be continuously trackable. The rebound comes from the physical compression of the black elastic surface, not flying, teleporting, rope pulling, or superpowers.

---
Negative:

Changing @图片1 (@Image 1) character styling, redesigning clothing, clothing drift, face drift, character replacement,
mid-way cuts, camera teleporting, scene jumping, the cameraperson suddenly appearing on the ground, third-person aerial shot,
the protagonist directly flying, hovering, invisible rope pulling up, anti-gravity, instantly returning to the rooftop,
no elastic device, wrong landing point, landing on the rainbow light ring, hitting buildings, hitting the parapet,
rebounding early before contact, elastic surface not sinking, device rupturing, device deforming and disappearing,
fall direction changing, ascent route deviating, body passing through the elastic surface, abnormal character size,
limbs twisting during flips, extra arms, extra legs, joints bending backward, body melting, duplicated characters,
landing without weight, landing standing straight, feet penetrating the ground, falling and getting injured, blood, serious injury,
friends blocking the camera early, crowd frozen, phone deforming, high-rises bending, vehicles floating,
anime rendering, game CG, plastic skin, cheap green screen, excessive light effects, excessive slow motion,
subtitles, on-screen text, watermark, brand logo, narration, extra dialogue

extra-3cfdd339e0cf.zh-Hans: 基于穿搭展示板布局，创建一段干净、高级的8秒时尚信息图动画。整个构图在白色极简背景上保持完整可见。右侧的女性模特开始绕其垂直轴进行流畅的360°旋转，如同时尚展示转台。她的动作优雅而连续，保持自然姿态和真实的布料物理效果。头发、裙带和配饰对运动做出细微反应。与此同时，编号方框内展示的每一件物品都同步旋转：项链缓慢进行3D旋转，展现链条层次和吊坠细节。发结围绕其中心优雅旋转。手持游戏机像产品广告一样绕其垂直轴旋转。工装迷你裙旋转360°以展示正面、侧面和背面视图。厚底靴像奢侈品产品展示渲染一样一起旋转。黑色露肩上衣平滑旋转以展示完整服装廓形。所有物品以与模特旋转速度完美同步的方式完成旋转。方框、编号、排版和布局保持位置固定，只有产品在其框架内旋转。镜头基本保持静止，带有微妙的电影感推近。柔和影棚灯光，真实阴影，干净的商业时尚广告美学，超清晰细节，高级动态图形，平滑缓动，奢华目录展示，4K，60fps。

extra-c73b214a2d22.zh-Hans: 一位时尚的年轻女子在黄金时段自信地走在繁忙的纽约市人行道上，身穿深色修身T恤、宽松深色牛仔裤和运动鞋，一边用智能手机通话，一边拿着一杯冰咖啡和一份咖啡馆菜单，身旁有一只牵着牵引绳的金毛寻回犬同行；突然，她绊了一下，在迈步途中掉落手机、冰咖啡杯和一张“YA HALA COFFEE - FALL MENU”传单，使这些物品以慢动作悬停在半空中，伴随魔法般的液体飞溅和漂浮的秋叶，随后过渡到品牌咖啡杯和显示着来自“BOSS”来电的智能手机的微距特写，最后一切以充满动感、高能量的商业电影风格落回地面。
